_comment: ICU data filter for ESCARGOT_LIBICU_SUPPORT_VENDORED (see build/VendoredICU.cmake).
Consumed via the ICU_DATA_FILTER_FILE env var during the vendored third_party/icu
build. No feature exclusions right now: an earlier pass excluded 'coll'/'coll_tree'
on the assumption Intl.Collator wasn't implemented -- it is, and excluding them
broke 13 intl402 Collator/getCollations tests (caught by the vendored-icu CI job's
test262 run). 'Escargot doesn't call this today' isn't a safe reason to drop a data
tree on its own -- it may still be needed once a feature gets implemented later, or
reachable through a path this pass didn't trace. Only exclude something here once
it's verified (via test262, not assumption) that dropping it is actually safe.
